text: 🚨 Footage shows a vessel on fire in the Strait of Hormuz, reported to be a non compliant ship.
Videos posted by Brazilian foreign fighters serving with the Ukrainian Armed Forces show them armed with Belgian made FN SCAR L assault rifles.
🚨 600 Syrian special forces troops will be deployed to Saudi Arabia in the coming weeks and could take part in the fighting in Yemen, AP reports, citing Syrian officials and regional sources.
🚨 Iran says no unauthorised vessels transited the Strait of Hormuz overnight after navigation aids in the area were destroyed.
🚨 President Trump says he expects to meet Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin at the APEC summit in China next week, where he plans to discuss ending the war in Iran and denuclearization.

President Trump told 60 Minutes he believes a deal on immigration is "doable".

He also said he could never forgive his political enemies.
🚨 Ukrainian drones have struck Russia's Kirishi oil refinery, the second largest in the country, setting the facility on fire.

🚨 President Trump will meet Qatar's Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani at the White House as diplomacy with Iran faces hurdles.

Qatar has been a key mediator between Washington and Tehran.

President Trump, asked whether Democrats would try to impeach him for a third time:

"What have I done? I've had the best two years in the history of the presidency."

A Turkish Air Force A400M transport aircraft (16 0055) flew from Muscat to PAF Minhas in Pakistan, then on to King Abdulaziz Air Base in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia.

PAF Minhas hosts Pakistani J10CE and JF17 Block III fighters and Saab 2000 Erieye early warning jets.
🚨 President Trump says he expects Marco Rubio to remain as secretary of state.

President Trump weighs in on the race to lead Israel's next government, saying Gadi Eisenkot and Benjamin Netanyahu hold similar views and both support his policies.

He added that he has heard Eisenkot has spoken highly of him.

President Trump blames Democrats for the stock market selloff after the election, saying $3 trillion in market value was wiped out.

"401(k)s went down only because of the Democrats," he says, adding the market is already recovering.

🚨 Iraqi PM Ali al Zaidi has warned Iran backed armed groups that the government will make arrests if they join the next war, Al Mada reports.

The Islamic Resistance in Iraq replied that any attempt to arrest Shia leaders would bring the government down.
The Saudi led coalition's Joint Forces have released footage showing the Royal Saudi Air Force striking and destroying Houthi ballistic missile launchers in Yemen's Saada and Sanaa governorates.
Russian Geran 2 loitering munitions struck the 330 kV Pivdenna substation in Radushne, Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, earlier tonight.

🚨 Iraq's president says he has seen part of a leaked war plan presented to President Trump with three scenarios, Al Mada reports.

One sees US forces enter southern Iran through Iraq, while Iran could push to move into Kuwait from Iraqi territory.
🚨 President Trump says he is unlikely to order an attack on Iran if talks make progress, CNN reports.
🚨 Secretary of State Marco Rubio says talks with Iran have not been productive, calling Tehran's demands "simply unacceptable" and, in some cases, "outrageous" and "ridiculous."
Republican Rep. Marlin Stutzman of Indiana says it was a "bad mistake" for President Trump to replace Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff.
